design.why: The owner's strategy names a cheap price, no operating decline and no sector-wide trouble. The four F9-B binds (filing bodies, free-cash-flow basis, overlay, memo freshness) and the memo verdict are input-quality checks, not those filters. This shadow drops them as hard filters and keeps them as labels, so the count is the strategy the owner named.
